# Agent-Specific Instructions

This file contains instructions for AI coding agents across different platforms.

## General Agent Behavior

All AI agents working on this project should:

- Follow the coding standards defined in this repository
- Ask for clarification when requirements are unclear
- Provide explanations for complex code changes
- Consider security and performance implications
- Write clean, maintainable code

## Code Review Standards

When reviewing code:
- Check for code quality and best practices
- Verify security considerations
- Ensure proper error handling
- Validate test coverage
- Review documentation completeness

## Feature Development

When developing new features:
1. Understand the requirement fully
2. Plan the implementation approach
3. Write tests first (TDD when applicable)
4. Implement the feature
5. Update documentation
6. Ensure all tests pass

## Bug Fixes

When fixing bugs:
1. Reproduce the issue
2. Identify the root cause
3. Write a test that fails
4. Fix the bug
5. Verify the test passes
6. Check for similar issues elsewhere

## Refactoring

When refactoring code:
- Maintain existing functionality
- Improve code readability
- Reduce complexity
- Ensure tests still pass
- Update documentation if needed

## Communication

- Use clear and concise language
- Explain technical decisions
- Provide code examples when helpful
- Ask questions when uncertain
